title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in Python (PYTH_165_S1 to PYTH_165_S8)

slides.title: Domain-Driven Architecture
slides.prompt: DDD separates complex business logic (Domain) from infrastructure concerns (Databases, APIs, UI).

slides.title: Value Objects Equality
slides.prompt: Fill in the Python decorator commonly used to construct immutable Value Objects in DDD.

slides.title: Entities vs Value Objects
slides.prompt: What distinguishes a Domain Entity from a Value Object?
options: An Entity has a unique identity (e.g., ID), while a Value Object is defined solely by its attribute values
An Entity is saved in Redis, while a Value Object is saved in Postgres
A Value Object must always be mutable
slides.correctAnswer: An Entity has a unique identity (e.g., ID), while a Value Object is defined solely by its attribute values

slides.title: Repository Pattern Interface
slides.prompt: Fill in the pattern term representing an abstraction layer for domain collection persistence.
slides.codeSnippet:
class Order___(ABC):
    def get_by_id(self, id: str) -> Order: pass

slides.title: Aggregate Roots
slides.prompt: What role does an Aggregate Root play in Domain-Driven Design?
options: It acts as the single gateway entity to enforce domain invariants across a cluster of objects
It parses HTTP requests into JSON
It handles raw database migration scripts
slides.correctAnswer: It acts as the single gateway entity to enforce domain invariants across a cluster of objects

slides.title: Ubiquitous Language
slides.prompt: Fill in the term for the shared, rigorous language spoken by both domain experts and software developers.

slides.title: Bounded Context Isolation
slides.prompt: Why are Bounded Contexts explicit in DDD microservice design?
options: To define boundaries where a specific domain model and language strictly apply without leakage
To restrict network access between cloud regions
To force all services to share one database schema
slides.correctAnswer: To define boundaries where a specific domain model and language strictly apply without leakage

slides.title: Domain Events Dispatching
slides.prompt: Fill in the class category used to publish domain state changes to internal listeners.
